A router that only treats 429 as 'quota exhausted' will misclassify every Kimi Code quota block. notes: LIMIT-HIT: HTTP 429, machine-readable and specific. Body observed live: {"type":"error","error":{"type":"GoUsageLimitError","message":"Go usage limit exceeded"},"metadata":{"workspace":"wrk_01KTAE41F8R7RHXXKYV3E7JFF9","limitName":"monthly"}}. metadata.limitName names the exhausted window ('monthly'), and a retry-after header carries seconds (observed 1174892). Recovery is SECONDS, not a lockout. Separately: retired models answer HTTP 410 Gone with a dated detail, so a lane MUST refresh its model list.
